news-korea-econ.title: Peter Schweizer: ‘Kids Are Getting Dumber' in the Age of AI -- Discipline Is the Solution, Not Money & Gadgets
news-korea-econ.description: Throwing money at the education system has not raised student achievement, and the looming rise of artificial intelligence won’t help students who can’t read and write well enough to manage it. In a world where knowledge is the key to future success, students…
